producer_report_forwarded_to_review.estimand: mubar_k = E[C(S,k)]/C(n_e,k), the AVERAGE k-way joint inner-block failure probability, reported as log2 A_k = log2(mubar_k / q^k), primary order k = m = delta_e+1 (16/17/30). Not the DFR, not pairwise correlation - the two gates BATCH-003 was opened to enforce.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.defect_found_in_the_inherited_input: THE PRODUCER CONTRADICTS ITS OWN PRIMARY INPUT AND RESOLVES IT. a17_characterization.md Lemma L1 claims the F_j are EXCHANGEABLE; its cyclic-shift argument yields only equal marginals plus translation invariance, because shifting by n_2 maps block n_e-1 outside the retained window. Resolution: the estimand is the AVERAGE mubar_k, for which Jordan inversion and the estimator's unbiasedness hold with NO exchangeability assumption. NOTE FOR THE REVIEWERS: this points the same way as the sibling oracle's independent Lemma R (the ring is not subset-exchangeable, only cyclic-orbit constant). THE COORDINATOR IS NOT CLAIMING INDEPENDENT CONVERGENCE - both tasks read the same characterization document, so this is corroboration from two directions, not two independent discoveries. That distinction is exactly the one TASK-20260802-caddef objection O9 caught the Coordinator getting wrong before.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.feasibility_verdict: MIXED, AND THE HEADLINE IS A NEGATIVE. At HQC's OWN parameters the measurement is INFEASIBLE by 33+ orders of magnitude at k=m (T_req = 3.4e41 / 1e59.8 / 1e79.9), because T_req is approximately 1/DFR. It is FEASIBLE at reduced sets: PS-R1 reaches k = m = 16 exactly with a 3.4x margin, PS-R3 up to k=22, PS-R5 up to k=30, and true-HQC-1 PS-A at k=2,3 only. CRITICALLY, THE LADDER HAS EXACTLY TWO RUNGS: any intermediate duplication (dup=2) costs 3.2e20 core-seconds, so there is NO WALKABLE PATH from dup=1 to HQC's dup in {3,5}.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.biggest_threat_named_by_the_producer: THE RARITY GAP, and it is O-6's obstruction RELOCATED RATHER THAN REMOVED. The design matches the moment order m exactly but sits at m/lambda in [0.70, 1.51] against HQC-1's 1264 - a factor of about 840, tested over 0.33 decades and applied over 2.9 more. That is HEUR-HQC-3, which the producer names as the weakest link and declares to have NEITHER a rigorous NOR a classical justification half.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.second_threat: WASH-OUT. Any reduction pushing p* or q toward 1/2 destroys the dependence and would yield a null that FALSELY CONFIRMS A17. Guarded by holding p* at each level's published value, a gamma-hat < 0.95 gate, and a pre-registered rule that a null at a washed-out set is UNINFORMATIVE, NOT evidence for A17.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.null_object: Three arms. CTRL-BS (primary) block-shuffles across distinct independent true trials, so it is i.i.d. by construction with the EXACT true marginal block law and E[A-hat_k] = 1 exactly. INV-NULL is pre-registered before any number exists: |log2 A-hat_k^null| > 3 SE_null on any arm, or null excess > 25% of the (T) excess, marks that (set,k) invalid_measurement - never a negative observation. Nulls run BEFORE (T) at each set and are never the arm cut under budget pressure.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.space_T_guarantees: Fixed-weight index sampling with no Bernoulli step anywhere, five independent PRNG streams, and the (M) generator confined to a separate module used only by the NULL-M arm. Five drift detectors D1-D5, including gamma-hat which is exactly 1 on (M) versus a published-derived 0.61-0.74 on (T).
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.heuristics: 8, each with formal statement, obstructions, falsification condition and validation plan. THREE declare a MISSING classical justification half and HEUR-HQC-7 declares a missing rigorous half with the requirement recorded as unmet - declared rather than papered over.
producer_report_forwarded_to_review.cost: 5.58e4 core-seconds modeled, 8 runs of at most 3600 s wall on at most 4 cores, under 1 GB, with a declared 2x contingency and six flagged optimistic assumptions. Machine constants from generic NON-HQC microbenchmarks.

coordinator_position: The reviewers are asked to test the feasibility arithmetic hardest. BATCH-002 established that verifying numbers is necessary and NOT sufficient - the A19 retarget had correct arithmetic and failed on what the numbers meant. The same standard applies here, in both directions: an over-optimistic T_req wastes BATCH-004, and an over-pessimistic one would abandon a measurement this campaign exists to make.
